event.comment: Demonstration decision: best-effort recording accepted for Q-1 (bounded queue, counted drops, flush on shutdown, documented loss cases); 90-day retention; additive contract.

event.title: Recording durability (Q-1)
event.choice: Best effort: bounded ArrayBlockingQueue (10,000), batched inserts every second; full queue drops and counts; graceful shutdown flushes
event.rationale: No database work on the redirect path and bounded memory; losses are visible in metrics
alternatives: Synchronous insert (adds a write to every redirect)
Kafka (new infrastructure for an internal statistic)

event.title: Where clicks are recorded
event.choice: After a successful resolve in RedirectController
event.rationale: 404/410 are not clicks; the controller already has the headers

event.title: Click key
event.choice: Store the code, not the link id
event.rationale: Codes are never reused; recording needs no extra lookup

event.title: Privacy
event.choice: Referrer host and agent family only
event.rationale: Enough for campaign analysis; no personal data

event.title: Retention
event.choice: Purge clicks older than 90 days hourly; days window capped at 90
event.rationale: Bounded table growth; stats never promise data that was purged

event.title: Issue #1
event.choice: Cache (target, expiresAt) and re-check expiry on every lookup
event.rationale: Correct at the exact instant with no database access on hits
